hear-no-dub.config.title: Hear No Dub
hear-no-dub.config.enabled.desc: Same as the toggle key (J by default).
hear-no-dub.config.auto_search.desc: When a new video starts, search OpenSubtitles and load the best match automatically. Each new video uses one of your daily downloads; rewatching uses the cache.
hear-no-dub.config.toasts.desc: Small pop-ups when subtitles are found, missing or fail to load.
hear-no-dub.config.nudge.desc: How far one press of [ or ] moves the subtitles.
hear-no-dub.config.account.help: Free account at opensubtitles.com. Create an API key under Profile > API consumers. Username and password are optional but give you more daily downloads. They're saved in plain text in config/hear-no-dub.json, so use a password you don't use elsewhere.
hear-no-dub.config.username.desc: Optional. Logging in raises the daily download limit.
hear-no-dub.config.move.desc: Drag the caption box to where you want it.
hear-no-dub.config.width.desc: Lines longer than this wrap. Up to 3 lines are shown.
